brief:
Palestine News Network's "Accountability" programme explored Palestinian strategies for safeguarding traditional crafts and heritage industries while expanding market access for local products, the network reported. The episode, produced in Bethlehem, focused on how Palestinians balance preservation of cultural heritage with economic development through local production.

The programme examined resilience mechanisms within Palestinian communities, highlighting the role of traditional crafts and heritage industries in sustaining livelihoods and cultural identity amid broader economic pressures.

title: PNN examines Palestinian efforts to protect heritage crafts
